---
title: "Ensemble models (upper bound on discrimination)"
output: html_document
params:
  cores: 1
---

Reproduces **Figure 1** (jaundice onset within 30 days), **Figure S2** (within 14 days)
and **Figure S4** (children under 14, South Sudan), and the AUCs quoted in the Results.

**Runtime:** each model refits the ensemble once per patient. With `cores = 1` this
takes several hours (most of it Bangladesh, n = 1,625). To run faster, knit with
`rmarkdown::render("02_ensemble_models.Rmd", params = list(cores = 8))`; results then
differ slightly in the third decimal place from the sequential run (see `R/ensemble.R`).

Not reproduced here: Figure S3 (Bangladesh symptoms on the day of admission), because
that variable is not in the analytic dataset.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
source(here("R", "data.R"))
source(here("R", "ensemble.R"))

ssd <- load_ssd() %>% select(-all_of(SSD_RARE_SYMPTOMS))
ssd_children <- load_ssd(children = TRUE) %>% select(-all_of(SSD_RARE_SYMPTOMS))
bd <- load_bd()
```

## South Sudan

```{r ssd}
set.seed(1234)
ssd_30 <- run_ensembles(ssd, SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "South Sudan, <=30 days", params$cores)
ssd_14 <- run_ensembles(filter(ssd, days_since_ajs_baseline <= 14), SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS,
                        "South Sudan, <=14 days", params$cores)
```

## Bangladesh

```{r bd}
set.seed(12345)
bd_30 <- run_ensembles(bd, BD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "Bangladesh, <=30 days", params$cores)
bd_14 <- run_ensembles(filter(bd, days_since_ajs <= 14), BD_DEMOGRAPHICS,
                       "Bangladesh, <=14 days", params$cores)
```

## Children under 14 (South Sudan)

```{r children}
set.seed(1234)
ssd_kids <- run_ensembles(ssd_children, SSD_DEMOGRAPHICS, "South Sudan children", params$cores)
```

## AUCs

```{r auc}
aucs <- bind_rows(ssd_30$auc, bd_30$auc, ssd_14$auc, bd_14$auc, ssd_kids$auc)
aucs %>% mutate(across(c(auc, lower, upper), ~ round(., 2)))
```

## Figures

```{r figures, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
# Figure 1
plot_grid(plot_roc(ssd_30$roc, "red", "A"), plot_roc(bd_30$roc, "orange", "B"))
# Figure S2
plot_grid(plot_roc(ssd_14$roc, "red", "A"), plot_roc(bd_14$roc, "orange", "B"))
# Figure S4
plot_roc(ssd_kids$roc, "red")
```
